messages:
emma-support: Heads up — multiple customers (acme-inc, shoply, and an internal partner) opened escalations around 04:18 UTC about intermittent 502/504s and client-side timeouts targeting eu-west hosted endpoints. Failures spike on batched payloads.

raj-sre: Drop a representative trace ID so we can pull gateway traces and router metrics?

emma-support: trace_id=ef9a1d4c. Payloads were batches of 612 items, avg seq_len ~900. Redacted sample attached to ticket.

incident-bot: War room created: #warroom-1778009999 (lead: raj-sre). Paging oncall and runtime.

zach-oncall: Proxy metrics show a 04:1504:25 UTC burst of upstream 5xxs from eu-west. Gateway backlog climbed; model workers reported long GC pauses and high RSS.

ana-runtime: We shipped a minor routing preference yesterday (favor newer shards). Canary ok for typical traffic but not large-batch patterns; this could concentrate load and cause cache churn.

liam-platform: Routing diff: prefer_new_shards=true	6 that can reduce shard spread under certain heuristics.

raj-sre: Traces indicate grpc deadline_exceeded 1 504s, and kv-cache miss rate jumped with eviction logs. Hypothesis: routing change + concentrated batch traffic 1 cache churn 1 longer setup per request 1 queue growth 1 gateway timeouts.

emma-support: Customers say failures were bursty, coinciding with batch submissions between 04:1704:22 UTC.

ana-runtime: Reproduced locally with batch_size=10, seq_len=1024; observed queue growth and sporadic OOMs on shard-2. Short-term mitigations: cap batch size, shift heavy tenants, temporarily increase gateway concurrency.

sara-product: I’ll draft a short customer message: "We’re applying mitigations to reduce failures for batched requests; we’ll update in 30 minutes." Keep it concise.

kyle-customer-success: I’ll notify acme-inc and shoply; please provide ETA on mitigations.

raj-sre: Immediate mitigation steps:
- Override max_batch_size → 4 for impacted routes
- Route heavy-tenant traffic to fallback shard (variant-small)
- Temporarily bump eu-west gateway concurrency by +25%
- Pre-warm top prompt prefixes into KV cache

liam-platform: Rolling routing override now (canary → 50% → 100%). Applying batch cap. ETA ~10m.

zach-oncall: Gateway cap increased for eu-west. Monitoring 5xx counts.

anna-monitoring: After changes, 5xx rate decreased ~70% within 12 minutes. Tail latency improved but minor spikes persist during aggressive bursts.

ana-runtime: Staging repro confirms bursty GC and cache misses. Medium-term fix: add batcher backpressure when queue depth exceeds threshold and reduce prefetch window.

raj-sre: Post-incident action items (owner	7 ETA):
- Batcher backpressure heuristic (ana-runtime	7 72h)
- Per-tenant shard isolation to avoid consolidation (liam-platform	7 5d)
- Expose per-tenant batch limits in Console (sara-product	7 7d)
- Composite alert for kv_cache_miss_rate + shard_queue_depth (anna-monitoring	7 48h)
- Playbook entry + customer templates for high-batch incidents (kyle-customer-success & sara-product	7 24h)
- Add large-batch replay to canary tests (eng-ml	7 5d)

sara-product: Proposal: temporarily lower hosted default max_batch_size to 8 while runtime fixes are delivered. I’ll scope customer communications and pricing impact.

kyle-customer-success: Sent initial notices to affected customers; they requested a follow-up call if we don’t fully stabilize within 2 hours.

raj-sre: I’ll own the RCA write-up: timeline, hypothesis, repro steps, mitigations, and the action list. Target draft by EOD tomorrow.

zach-oncall: Incident marked mitigated at 05:02 UTC after stabilization. No data exposure or billing anomalies detected. War room remains open for action confirmations.

emma-support: Added customer repro and trace to ticket. Will post the 30m update and link to the postmortem draft when available.

incident-bot: Follow-up tasks created and linked to incident-1778009999. Assignees set.

raj-sre: Leaving thread open for additional postmortem comments1 please add any other action items here.
